description: Start chosen Claude Code threads in Code Mode, where Claude writes scripts that call tools and filter their output. A sticky composer button opts in the threads you send from the app, and the bb claude-code-mode spawn command does it for agents and scripts. A badge above the composer marks a Code Mode thread, and resumed sessions keep the mode. Needs Claude Code CLI 2.1.323 or later, a 5.5 or Fable 5.2 model and macOS or Linux; the mode is experimental, lacks Claude in Chrome, computer use and Remote Control, and the plugin routes every Claude Code launch on the bb server's machine through its wrapper script.
